title: AGNow,
summary: Audiogames usually have to be downloaded, installed and kept up to date, and most of them only run on Windows. AGNow runs them for you instead: the game runs on the server, and you hear it and play it from wherever you are, without installing anything. • Nothing to install. Games play in the browser. There are also apps for Windows, Mac and iPhone if you would rather have one. • Your own screen reader does the talking. What a game would say to NVDA is passed to the screen reader you already use, in your voice and at your speed. • Your progress is kept. Saved games stay on the server, so you can start on one device and carry on from another. • Short breaks are fine. Leave a game running and it will still be there when you get back, rather than having to be started again. It is for stepping away rather than for tomorrow, though — a game nobody comes back to is closed after a while. • Nobody has to play alone. Add friends, send messages, and let people listen in on what you are playing — or hand them a turn. • Free to play, within reason. A free account gets 12 hours of play time a month, a new one plays without a limit for its first 30 days, and there is a paid tier if you want no limit at all.

title: Path of Adventure 2
summary: When you discover a trail of old cairns, little do you know that you've just set out on the Path of Adventure. The fabled Path, though now mostly forgotten, winds through dungeons and wild lands, past monsters and traps — all the way down into the Undeep. How far will you come? - No ads - Offline - Standalone sequel (you don't need to have played part 1) Path of Adventure 2 is a text-based roguelike RPG. A unique blend of CYOA and D&D! Text-based Step into a fantasy narrative and decide how YOU want to act. Will you dare to leap over the snake pit? Explore that gloomy cave? And what will you offer the ancient statue? Roguelike The path is procedurally generated using random events, enemies and loot. Each death teaches you more about the world, bringing you closer to a well-deserved victory. RPG Develop your character's Strength, Dexterity, and Intelligence, and gather the best gear to match. Manage resources, inflict status effects, and defeat monsters in turn-based combat. Easy to learn, hard to master Never played a game like this before? No problem! Just start with the tutorial and continue your journey. New characters and game modes unlock as you play; plenty of challenge awaits! Accessible Path of Adventure 2 is optimized for screen readers, thanks to the support of the community of blind and visually impaired players.

title: AudioGameAccess
summary: AudioGameAccess is a platform of games played entirely by ear, made for blind and visually impaired people. Sounds guide you, and VoiceOver tells you everything else. The games: - archery, in three levels, and bowling; - Feather Flight, a skill game; - card games: Ninety-nine, Crazy Eights, Golf, President, a colour card game, and a car race played with cards; - dice games: a five-dice game, with its combinations to fill, and Farkle; - board games: Parcheesi and Camembert Culture, a general knowledge quiz; - Four in a Row, a puzzle game: be the first to line up four tokens in an upright grid; - hangman, Sea Battle and a word game on a grid of letters; - One Word, a cooperative word game online, for 3 to 8 players: each one helps a player guess a mystery word, with a single word; - Métropole, a city-building game where you are the mayor. Every game has its own manual, in English, French, Spanish, Italian and Portuguese. On iPhone, two ways to play: - with VoiceOver, the whole screen becomes the game: you play with gestures, without looking for buttons; - without VoiceOver, real buttons, cards and dice to touch, in large text and high-contrast colours for visually impaired players. Play with others: online, open a table, invite your friends or play against bots. Chat in writing and by voice, send private messages, keep a friends list and follow the leaderboards. A game can be saved and resumed later. Offline, every game but One Word can be played alone or against bots, with no account. To play online, create a free account with your email address. Other players never see it. You can block or report a player, and delete your account from the app. 3D sound on headphones places every sound around you.

title: Voice-enabled Makeup Assistant
summary: This innovative app offers audio feedback on the user’s foundation, eyeshadow and lipstick application, creating a more accessible beauty experience for the Blind and visually impaired. How It Works: The AI-powered Voice-enabled Makeup Assistant leverages machine learning and voice instruction technologies to learn your preferences and provide audio feedback when you ask. After you apply your foundation, eyeshadow or lipstick, the app will access your phone’s front camera to scan your face. Using artificial intelligence, it identifies the makeup applied to your face, eyes and lips and assesses the uniformity and boundaries of application and coverage. If there are suggested areas to touch up, the virtual assistant identifies them and makes audible recommendations so you can adjust your look. After your touch up, the app scans your face again and provides feedback on the accuracy of application.

title: GemGame: Cozy Match 3 Puzzle
summary: A cozy match 3 puzzle with no ads and offline play, now in a rich new Velvet design. Swap jewels, chain sparkling cascades and restore a magical garden, one clever move at a time. Discover five connected worlds, from the Living Conservatory to the Heart of the Void. Make clever matches, face each guardian and bring its world back to life. PLAYABLE WITH VOICEOVER GemGame plays with VoiceOver. Every gem and obstacle on the board has a clear spoken label, a Board status element counts obstacles and ingredients, and a Special gems element counts specials. Each move is summarised after it settles, including the chain multiplier. Purchased hints name the exact pair to swap, and rejected moves explain why without spending a move. AWAKEN THE FIVE WORLDS Restore the Conservatory's light, reconnect the Nebula Waterways, unfold the Aurora Observatory, illuminate the Plasma Forge and awaken the Heart of the Void. Your campaign progress makes each transformation permanent. Return to choose free lighting, replay the awakening and pursue optional mastery. LEARN A SPECTACULAR NEXT MOVE Try five world encounters in the free Jewel Lab. Experiment with real puzzle rules and unlimited practice retries, without spending lives or earning campaign rewards. Combine striped, wrapped, rainbow and comet specials, clear obstacles and take on cosmic guardians. A GARDEN WORTH COMING BACK TO Restore fountains, flowering corners and peaceful places to sit. Choose decorative finishes, discover new districts and welcome butterflies, songbirds and other woodland visitors as you play. A LITTLE ADVENTURE, YOUR WAY • Daily Star: a fresh free puzzle each day, with no life cost. Keep your streak going. • Relic Run: draft relics and climb five boards in a single free run. • Weekend Gauntlet: a Friday-to-Sunday sudden-death ladder. How far can you climb? • The Atelier: discover cosmetic themes for your board. MAKE ROOM FOR A COZY MOMENT No ads interrupt your game. Core puzzles work offline, and levels are move-based, so there is no countdown rushing your next swap. Campaign lives refill over time; Daily Star gives you a free daily board without spending a life. GemGame is free to download. The optional Complete Collection is one permanent purchase: all five premium chapter reward tracks plus 50 Hard Mode puzzles. Rewards are earned as you play; the base campaign and garden remain free. Existing chapter-pass or Hard Mode owners receive the collection through Restore Purchases at no extra cost. Coin packs remain optional. Some decorative finishes require premium access. Purchases and Game Center features require an internet connection. Your next little escape is waiting.

title: Motif: Word Challenge
summary: Find ten hidden words every day and aim for the highest score on the daily grid! Motif is a strategic word game that combines clever wordplay with match-3-inspired mechanics. Free, ad-free, and no account required. THE WORD GAME WHERE WORDS HIDE! Swap letters, spot words, and plan your next move. Swipe across words to clear them from the grid. Every move shapes what comes next, so choose wisely! Everyone starts with the same grid. Submit your score if you’d like, and see where you rank on the daily leaderboard. NEW ASCENSION MODE! Motif becomes a full-blown adventure! Climb ten increasingly tough levels packed with bosses, special tiles, and bonuses galore. Motif has never played like this—and it’s free! ZEN MODES Want to play without the pressure? Zen Mode gives you fresh grids and the same rules, but with no word limit and no leaderboard. Take your time and play at your own pace. + “À LA CARTE” MODE! You set your own rules: swipe words bottom to top, right to left, in an L shape, use unlimited letter swaps… You call the shots. + M0T1F MODE! This time, numbers take the stage: swipe tiles to add them up and hit the target number. Careful, this one’s dangerously addictive! MAKE IT YOURS Customize Motif to suit your style: fonts, colors, tile shapes, score display, backgrounds… even the app icon. NO ADS. NO TRACKING. NO ACCOUNT. Just open Motif and start playing. No internet connection is required to play. The leaderboard is entirely optional. If you choose to participate, only your score, the date, and the grid language are submitted. No account, no advertising ID, and no player profile. Individual scores are deleted after 30 days.

title: Dugout Dice
summary: Roll dice. Build your lineup. Make the playoffs. Win a championship. Beat the target score before three outs to advance to the next inning. Win games, make the playoffs and win championships to unlock new players, Superfan boosts, cheat menus and more. Fall short, and your season is over. Every season is a chance to build something different. Recruit players with special abilities, add Superfan boosts, and upgrade your dice. Discover powerful combinations, stack multipliers, and turn modest hits into massive payoffs with one-time consumables and clever bench management. **BUILD YOUR WINNING COMBO** - Draft players with abilities that stay with you during the season. - Combine Superfan Boosts, dice upgrades, and items for powerful combos. - Face pitchers and boss closers who challenge your best strategies. - Unlock new players, Boosts, and ballparks as you progress. - Take on a fresh Daily Diamond challenge to earn an advantage during your season. - Enjoy turn-based gameplay at your own pace. - Play offline and pick up right where you left off. **FREE TO PLAY. NO ADS. EVER.** An optional, one-time in-app purchase unlocks customization and fun extras.

title: xSearch for Safari
summary: # Featured in the App Store across 63 countries & regions # Featured on Dailytekk's YouTube channel: "BEST iPad Browser Extensions (Apps)" # Featured on Christopher Lawley's YouTube channel: "Must Have Safari Extension for iOS/iPadOS 15" # Featured on MacStories's YouTube channel: "Safari Extensions for iPhone and iPad" Upgrade your Safari browsing with xSearch, the all-in-one search tool for iOS, iPadOS, and macOS with just one purchase. xSearch lets you instantly switch between multiple search engines and even search directly from Spotlight, making your browsing faster and more efficient. For example, type "g apple" to search for "apple" using Google, or "ddg apple" to search with DuckDuckGo. Privacy is a top priority: xSearch requests only the permissions it needs. On iOS 17, iPadOS 17, macOS 14 and later, it requires permission to view browsing history to function properly within Safari, but it only accesses the current session's URL to identify the search engine. All processing is done locally, and your personal information never leaves your device, ensuring your privacy is fully protected. Some of xSearch's key features include: ■ Quickly switch between search engines using shortcuts. ■ Use URL Scheme to search within other apps, such as X (Twitter). ■ Customize Safari's default search engine with xSearch's variety of engines. ■ Multisearch capability enables simultaneous searching across multiple engines with a single shortcut. ■ Random mode in multisearch allows the system to automatically select an engine for you during searches. ■ Last Search Token remembers your previous query, letting you reuse it instantly without retyping. ■ Integration with Shortcuts provides convenient access to xSearch from anywhere. ■ Use the share extension to search any text in any app with xSearch. ■ Synchronize your search engines across all your devices with iCloud. ■ Backup and share your search engines using the export and import JSON file feature.

title: Tanklet: Idle Fish Aquarium
summary: Tanklet is a cozy aquarium game where you raise a tank of fish that's truly yours. Feed them, clean the tank, keep the water healthy, and watch them drift through a beautifully rendered aquarium — all the joy and companionship of fishkeeping, none of the cost or mess. ■ Care for your fish Feed on schedule, clean the tank, and manage water quality. Well-cared-for fish stay healthy, happy, and earn more coins. Neglect them and they get listless or sick — but good care always brings them back. Your fish never die. ■ Rare visitors Wild fish drop by from time to time. Feed them, keep the water clean, and set out the decorations they love — treat them well and they may stay for good. The rarer the visitor, the pickier they are. ■ Personalities & bonds Every fish has its own personality. Greet them daily and serve their favorite treats to deepen your bond, unlocking little stories and rewards. ■ Collect & breed From clownfish, blue tang and angelfish to golden arowana and koi, collect distinctive species and fill your codex. Breed pairs for offspring, with a chance at rare variants and shiny fish. ■ Eggs with honest odds Hatch mystery eggs for new species — drop rates are disclosed before every purchase, with a pity system that guarantees rare finds. ■ Send fish on treasure hunts Pick 1–2 fish for expeditions to the reef, a shipwreck, or the deep abyss. Hours later they return with coins, decorations — sometimes even pearls. Strong bonds and healthy fish bring better luck. ■ Make the tank yours Buy and freely place plants, driftwood, rocks and more. Resize, restyle, and decorate your tank exactly how you like it. ■ More tanks, real ecosystems Save up for more tanks, up to 6: freshwater, saltwater and coral ecosystems each boost matching fish. Every tank has its own theme and decorations, and fish can move anytime. ■ Ambient Mode: put your tank in a room Hide the interface and let your tank live in a warm little room. Nine rooms to swap — an indigo moon window, a brick loft, a green library, a coastal cottage… each room's light truly falls into the water. Keep the screen on and it becomes living furniture. ■ Grows while you're away Close the app and your fish keep you company while coins keep accruing. Come back to collect offline earnings and see what happened. ■ Calm, anywhere A Home Screen widget brings your tank to your desktop; soft water-sound ambience helps you unwind; iCloud keeps your tank in sync across devices. No ads, no third-party SDKs, zero data collection — your tank is yours alone. Subscribe to Tanklet+ for double coins, offline earnings extended 8→24 hours, auto-care while away, a monthly pearl gift, and exclusive decor. Slow down. Keep some fish. Privacy Policy: https://smartkiitos.com/tanklet/privacy/ Terms of Use: https://smartkiitos.com/tanklet/terms/

title: Oath & Ash
summary: Oath & Ash (Eid & Asche) is a turn-based fantasy card game with detailed art, animated hero portraits and punchy battle sound. It is fully playable with VoiceOver. Every card, every enemy move and every result is announced, and nothing is ever timed. THREE HEROES, THREE WAYS TO PLAY The Knight holds the line with armor, guard and counterattacks. The Hunter sets traps, spreads poison and outlasts the enemy. The Mage controls the flow of cards with chains and frost. The Hunter unlocks after Act I, the Mage after Act II. Each hero has their own cards, deck and progress. THREE ACTS Walk the Thorn Path, cross the Ashlands and brave the Sand Sea. Each act has ten encounters, its own enemies and boss fights. Enemies show their next move before they make it, so you can plan ahead. Losing costs you no progress. Change your deck and try again. COLLECT AND UPGRADE Win cards in battle or open card boxes with three random cards. The app shows the odds for each rarity before you open a box. Salvage duplicates for Dust and use it to upgrade your favorite cards. Your deck is yours to build. SOMETHING NEW EVERY DAY Check the Daily tab for a new challenge each day, with its own rules and rewards. EXPEDITIONS Set out with a small deck and build it as you go. Three legs, each a map with branching paths to fights, rests, merchants and events, and a boss at the end. Relics give you lasting advantages, and your health carries over from fight to fight. In the weekly Expedition everyone plays the same map, and the top places in the ranking win weekly prizes. THE SEASON PATH Wins, duels and daily battles earn you embers to climb the Season Path: 40 levels of Dust, Diamonds, card boxes, titles, card backs, frames, avatars and victory lines. New looks arrive every month. The Path Letter opens a second track with more rewards. THE ARENA Duel the saved defense decks of real players. You play your turns, the game plays theirs. There is no turn timer, and every deck fights with its real card levels, so deckbuilding and tactics decide. If no player is a good match, a clearly labeled Arena Guardian steps in for half points. Climb from Starter through Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum to Diamond. Each season lasts one month, and the ranking shows your display name and avatar. Challenge friends to friendly duels with an invite link, and every profile shows league, heroes and collection. BUILT FOR VOICEOVER • Every value, card text and enemy intent is spoken • No time pressure, in the acts or in the Arena • Battle log with one heading per round for quick navigation • Narrator Helmut guides you in English and German • Every enemy has a voice of its own, and every boss its own music and entrance • You can hear when it's your turn, how hard a hit landed and when your health runs low • Settings, Learn the sounds lets you hear every sound and what it means • Support for larger text, reduced motion and haptic feedback GOOD TO KNOW Your progress is saved to your iCloud account, so you need to be signed in to iCloud on your device. Battles, Expeditions and the Arena need an internet connection. Your collection and the tutorial also work offline. Diamonds and the Path Letter are optional in-app purchases. There are no ads. Questions or problems? Reach us at support.kroegoor.com.
